opensslConfiguration.content:
# Scoped Community Build legacy TLS policy; no host configuration includes.
openssl_conf = cbodotnet_modules
[cbodotnet_modules]
ssl_conf = cbodotnet_ssl
[cbodotnet_ssl]
system_default = cbodotnet_tls
[cbodotnet_tls]
MinProtocol = TLSv1.2
CipherString = DEFAULT@SECLEVEL=2
